ValidationRule.description: Trigger an error if someone tries to change the status back to its prior value.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.Name == 'Customer Nudge', ISCHANGED(Status), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status ), "STATUS_SENT"), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'New') ), AND( ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status ), "STATUS_READ_BY_CUSTOMER"), OR ( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'New'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'STATUS_SENT') ) ), AND( ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status ), "STATUS_CUSTOMER_ARCHIVED"), OR ( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'New'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'STATUS_SENT'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'STATUS_READ_BY_CUSTOMER') ) ), AND( ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status ), "STATUS_COACH_ARCHIVED"), OR ( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'New'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'STATUS_SENT'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'STATUS_READ_BY_CUSTOMER'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'STATUS_CUSTOMER_ARCHIVED') ) ), AND( ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status ), "STATUS_AUTO_ARCHIVED"), OR ( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'New'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'STATUS_SENT'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'STATUS_READ_BY_CUSTOMER'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'STATUS_CUSTOMER_ARCHIVED'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'STATUS_COACH_ARCHIVED') ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Reverting the Status to a previous value is not allowed. Please select a different status.
